steps.name: Verify exact source revision before building
Rust toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install 1.98.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
rustup override set 1.98.1
$active = rustup show active-toolchain
Write-Host $active
if (-not $active.StartsWith('1.98.1')) {
  throw "Unexpected Rust toolchain: $active"
}
rustc --version
cargo --version

steps.name: Manual compatibility tooling smoke test
Real Edge and Chrome UIA adapter E2E
Windows hung and closing target E2E
First-run actual font and clipping QA
Release and branding checks
steps.run:
./scripts/release-check.ps1
$compat = "target/release/g-switcher-compatibility.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $compat -PathType Leaf)) {
  throw 'Compiled compatibility executable is missing from the release build.'
}
$compatHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $compat -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$compat.sha256" -Value "$compatHash  g-switcher-compatibility.exe" -Encoding ascii -NoNewline
Write-Host "Compatibility tool SHA256: $compatHash"

steps.name: Microsoft Defender scan
Verify exact clean source revision before packaging
Prepare public release package
steps.run:
$packageRoot = "target/release/g-switcher-2.0.1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $packageRoot -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher.exe -Destination $packageRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher.exe.sha256 -Destination $packageRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath README.md -Destination $packageRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath CHANGELOG.md -Destination $packageRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath RELEASE_NOTES_2.0.1.md -Destination $packageRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md -Destination $packageRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath COMPATIBILITY_2.0.1.md -Destination $packageRoot

$head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$rustVersion = (rustc --version).Trim()
$cargoVersion = (cargo --version).Trim()
$lockHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath Cargo.lock -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$exeHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$provenance = @(
  'G-switcher 2.0.1 build provenance',
  "commit=$head",
  "workflow_run_id=$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID",
  "workflow_run_number=$env:GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER",
  "rust=$rustVersion",
  "cargo=$cargoVersion",
  "cargo_lock_sha256=$lockHash",
  "g-switcher.exe_sha256=$exeHash"
)
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $packageRoot 'BUILD_PROVENANCE.txt') -Value $provenance -Encoding ascii

$zip = "target/release/g-switcher-2.0.1-windows-x64.zip"
Compress-Archive -Path "$packageRoot/*" -DestinationPath $zip -CompressionLevel Optimal
$hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$zip.sha256" -Value "$hash  g-switcher-2.0.1-windows-x64.zip" -Encoding ascii -NoNewline

steps.name: Prepare manual compatibility kit
steps.run:
$kitRoot = "target/manual-compatibility/g-switcher-2.0.1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $kitRoot -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher.exe -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher.exe.sha256 -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher-compatibility.exe -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher-compatibility.exe.sha256 -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath manual-browser-test-2.0.1.html -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath scripts/manual-compatibility-v201.ps1 -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath scripts/verify-compatibility-v201.ps1 -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath COMPATIBILITY_2.0.1.md -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath MANUAL_TESTING_2.0.1.md -Destination $kitRoot
Copy-Item -LiteralPath BROWSER_QUICK_TEST_2.0.1_RU.md -Destination $kitRoot

$head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$rustVersion = (rustc --version).Trim()
$cargoVersion = (cargo --version).Trim()
$lockHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath Cargo.lock -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$exeHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$compatHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath target/release/g-switcher-compatibility.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$provenance = @(
  'G-switcher 2.0.1 manual compatibility kit provenance',
  "commit=$head",
  "workflow_run_id=$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID",
  "workflow_run_number=$env:GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER",
  "rust=$rustVersion",
  "cargo=$cargoVersion",
  "cargo_lock_sha256=$lockHash",
  "g-switcher.exe_sha256=$exeHash",
  "g-switcher-compatibility.exe_sha256=$compatHash"
)
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kitRoot 'BUILD_PROVENANCE.txt') -Value $provenance -Encoding ascii

$manifest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $kitRoot -File |
  Sort-Object Name |
  ForEach-Object {
    $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    "$hash  $($_.Name)"
  }
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kitRoot 'SHA256SUMS.txt') -Value $manifest -Encoding ascii
